records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating revenues increased 20.3% in 2022 compared to 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Werner Logistics revenues are generated by its three operating units, following the sale of its WGL freight forwarding services for international ocean and air shipments in first quarter 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We had available liquidity of $523 million, considering cash on hand and available borrowing capacity of $416 million.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The increase in average revenues per tractor per week, net of fuel surcharge was due primarily to improved pricing in both Dedicated and One-Way Truckload, partially offset by a decline in miles per tractor.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Werner Logistics operating income increased to $36.2 million in 2022 compared to $27.9 million in 2021 and operating margin percentage increased to 4.6% in 2022 from 4.5% in 2021.
